title: Kestrel Delivery Pass Terms: Changing a Monthly Pass to Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
A patient holding a Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly or Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass in active status may switch to the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual and pays the switch charge for the annual pass's opening cycle, which starts on the switch date; the payment is booked as the subscription fee of that cycle. This charge applies to a patient who has had a Delivery Pass trial before; a patient who has not starts a trial, pays nothing on the switch and falls outside this computation.

## Who pays the switch charge

| Plan held | Plan status | Delivery Pass trial had before | On switching to Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly or Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | active | yes | pays the switch charge for the opening cycle |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly or Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | active | no | starts a trial and pays nothing on the switch |

## When the charge is fixed

The switch charge for the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual is fixed only after every order of the plan cancelled before dispatch carries a refund entry for each fee charged on it.

Restated: while any order of the plan that was cancelled before dispatch has a fee charged on it without a refund entry naming that fee, the switch charge is not yet fixed.

## Making the switch: `switch_delivery_pass_b46d5026`

**What it does.** The patient buys, in person with their own card, a different Kestrel delivery plan in place of the one they hold, and pays its opening billing cycle. One call changes the plan held on the same delivery plan record to the chosen plan, starts its billing cycle on the stated date, keeps the plan active, books the payment as the subscription fee of that new cycle and adds it to the fees the patient has paid on the plan. The cycle runs one billing period from its start date, its last day being one day short of the same date a period later: one calendar month for the monthly passes, twelve calendar months for the annual pass. Afterwards the patient sees the new plan name, the new cycle dates and the payment on the plan.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `switch_delivery_pass_b46d5026` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to make the switch and the payment.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `delivery_plan_id` | reference number of the patient's current delivery plan, as the delivery plan lookup shows it | id |
| `variant_name` | the plan being bought | exactly one of the plan names below |
| `cycle_start_date` | start date of the new plan's billing cycle | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount_usd` | the amount the patient pays for the new plan's opening billing cycle | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent before it is passed |

Values of `variant_name`: Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery (no subscription, fees per order); Kestrel Mail Delivery (no subscription, standard mail only); Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly (the monthly subscription pass for any adult); Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass (the monthly subscription pass for patients aged 65 or over); Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual (the yearly subscription pass); Kestrel Specialty Courier Service (the courier service for patients holding a Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription).

A start date that is not a valid calendar date is rejected with an error, and nothing is booked.

**Return.** A receipt listing `payment_reference` (the reference number of the booked subscription fee), `delivery_plan_id`, `variant_name` (the plan now held), `cycle_start_date` and `cycle_end_date` (the new billing cycle), `amount_usd` (the amount paid), `plan_status` (always "active") and `fees_net_usd` (the plan's fees paid net of refunds after this payment). A receipt carrying a payment reference means the switch and payment were booked.

## Hypothetical illustration of the cycle dates

An annual pass started on 2025-06-12 returns a cycle end date of 2026-06-11; a monthly pass started on 2025-06-12 returns 2025-07-11.
